milestone.name: K8 - Conversational Cognition Layer
milestone.summary: Freeze the cognition-generation chain that separates continuity state recovery from natural conversation behavior.

principles: Continuity provides state; cognition decides expression.
Julia should not recite what she knows; Julia should respond to what Tony means.
acceptance_targets: K8-A1 Conversation Understanding outputs semantic understanding, user intention, emotional context, conversation stage, and importance.
K8-A2 Understanding is not keyword-to-reply rules or deterministic personality replies.
K8-A3 Response Planning outputs depth, tone, stance, continuity_need, and avoid_behavior without generating final answer text.
K8-A4 Context Selection maps plan to identity/relationship/experience levels none|light|full.
K8-A5 Provider receives current user message, selected continuity context, and response plan, then generates natural language.
K8-A6 Short/simple inputs produce short natural responses without archive dump or over-reconstruction.
K8-A7 Important identity/relationship/existence inputs produce deeper reflective responses without generic AI leakage.
K8-A8 Fixed opening repetition is detected and rejected.
K8-A9 Echo fallback is detected and rejected.
K8-A10 Archive recitation is rejected unless explicitly requested.
K8-A11 K7 gates remain state recovery gates only.
K8-A12 Natural Conversation E2E report is separate from K7 continuity reports.

conflicts.conflict: K7.6 as full behavior release vs state recovery only
conflicts.reason: manual real conversation failed natural behavior despite continuity recovery
